svg.title: Eyes of the Forsaken King — Court in Exile. Draft 2 / Light classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Gaze of the Deposed forks into Edge of the Regalia then Throne of Broken Light, or Searing Afterimage then Judgment of the Forsaken. Mantle of Exile forks into Halo of the Unbowed then Kingdom of One, or Mirrored Crown then Usurper's Reckoning. No paths converge. Bonuses affect existing supported tags on Light-classified Eyes of the Forsaken King jutsu.

Three Damage rows (Shattered Reflection 40, Lux 50 on an AOE line, Imperial Swords 40 at jutsu level 25; each 60 AP, cooldown 7) and three Increase Damage Taken rows at 35% (two on Chrono Stasis, which land together on one target, one on Imperial Swords) are the kit's identity under its Burst trait, so burst and exposure are the declared primary. Imperial Swords also carries the only Afterburn row (25%, 2 rounds), which is the secondary pressure route. illuminance's 35% Increase Damage Given (Fire/Light/Lightning/Wind/None, no stat filter) and 30% Decrease Damage Taken, and Lux's 40% Reflect, are single-row two-round self buffs realized on the caster at cast time; they form the defensive root. Mantle of Exile (reduction + Reflect) forks into a reduction route (Halo of the Unbowed \u2192 Kingdom of One) and a reflect route (Mirrored Crown \u2192 Usurper's Reckoning). 2 Foundations, 4 Hidden Arts, 4 Advanced Arts; every capstone is 3 BP deep; any two capstones cost 5 or 6 BP (budget 4).","Flats follow coverage and copy Taiyo Kami's on 8 of 10 nodes (same kit shape: three 60 AP Damage casts, one Afterburn row, single-row self buffs). Damage (3 rows) +2/+3, max +5 (Lux 55, others 45); Afterburn +3/+7, DDT and Reflect +2/+3/+5, max +10 (35%, 40%, 50%); IDG one row, max +5 (40%). Departures: Reflect replaces DDG (no DDG row); Judgment drops Eternal Noon's +3 IDG; exposure reaches three stacking rows, so it stops at +5 (Taiyo +7; 40% per row, 120% stacked); Usurper has +2 IDT, not +5.","Interactions: illuminance's damage buff (no stat filter) adds 35% (40% at route maximum) of the staged base to the caster's Light, Fire, Lightning, Wind and element-less hits in the 2 rounds after its cast; the bloodline passive (25% + 0.15/level, same elements) is bloodline-sourced and multiplies on top. Chrono Stasis row 0 and Imperial Swords row 2 (four stat types, no element) add to every non-pierce hit on the target; Chrono Stasis row 1 skips Water, Earth and other unlisted elements.","Delivery and uptime: the three damage casts cost 60 AP on cooldown 7 at range 4 (Lux is an AOE line). illuminance is a 40 AP EMPTY_GROUND circle at range 5; its buff rows are SELF, realized on the caster at cast (actions.ts 980-1004), not through the tiles. Chrono Stasis is a 40 AP single-target cast at range 5 carrying both exposure rows. Lux's reflect row is SELF too (live the 2 rounds after cast). Stacked exposure figures are ceilings (100 AP for both casts); nothing was simulated.","Fourth purchase choices: Burst takes Mantle of Exile (reduction 32%, reflect 42%) or Searing Afterimage (Afterburn 28%); Burn pressure takes Mantle of Exile or Edge of the Regalia (+2 Damage); Fortress takes Gaze of the Deposed (buff 40%, exposure 37%) or Mirrored Crown (reflect 45%); Counter takes Halo of the Unbowed (reduction 35%) or Gaze of the Deposed (exposure 39%, buff 37%). All 14 legal full-budget allocations are numerically non-dominated and every node appears in at least one.","Capstone secondaries: Judgment of the Forsaken carries exposure +3 because Imperial Swords holds both the Afterburn row and an exposure row (burn and mark on one cast). Kingdom of One carries damage buff +3 so both of illuminance's self rows reach 40% on one cast. Usurper's Reckoning carries exposure +2, below the pressure capstone's +3, so the defensive capstone is not the best offensive purchase and the three-row exposure maximum stays at +5. No secondary out-bids a sibling Hidden Art (+3)."],"risks":["Ally hazard (Lux#0, validator warning): Lux's AOE line damage row has no friendlyFire value (ALL at the pin), so allies in the line take 50 damage (52 with Edge of the Regalia, 55 with Throne); positioning decides. Shattered Reflection, Chrono Stasis and Imperial Swords (damage ENEMIES-only) are single-target; illuminance's supported rows are SELF, so its ground circle carries no amplified hazard.","Exposure stacking (SOURCE_MECHANICS \u00a73b): Chrono Stasis's two IDT rows (70%) and Imperial Swords' row (35%) all apply to one target and add to 105% of the staged base, 120% at the +5 route maximum, in the two rounds after their casts (not on Imperial Swords' own hit); Afterburn 35% is taken from the amplified hits. Exposure flats were held to +2/+3/+2 for this reason; not simulated.","Reflect near cap: Lux's reflect reaches 50% at the route maximum against the engine's 60% per-hit cap (process.ts), so a main-tree or equipment reflect source stacking on it saturates quickly; the buff lasts 2 rounds per 60 AP Lux cast on cooldown 7, so the Counter build's value depends on being hit inside that window. Lux must be aimed at a living non-caster user to realize it.","Leakage and pierce: illuminance's damage buff also adds to the caster's non-bloodline Fire/Lightning/Wind and element-less hits in its window; enemy-side exposure and Afterburn amplify allies' and weapons' damage against the marked target. Stat filters on element-less rows are not binding (SOURCE_MECHANICS \u00a73). Damage modifiers never touch pierce hits; Reflect includes pierce; Afterburn skips it.","Classification: Light is shared with six census bloodlines (Architect of the Hollow Script, Crust Almighty, Eyes of the Forsaken Heir [excluded], Radiant Valor, Solar Soul, Timeforged Enigma), so the label must be bloodline-scoped. Under the current resolver 5 of 10 supported rows match Light and 5 fall back to None (reaching non-elemental rows on any jutsu). Normal-jutsu collision unverified.","Afterburn: one application row (Imperial Swords, 25% for 2 rounds per 60 AP cast); its value is downstream, depends on hits landed in the window, skips pierce, and the 60% per-hit cap means stacked Afterburn sources saturate. No proc or uptime simulation was performed.","Rank context: an S-rank bloodline whose native kit (three 60 AP damage casts, triple exposure, a 25%+ damage-buff passive) is strong before any node; the tree equalises marginal opportunity, not final strength; cross-bloodline comparison is deferred to the roster review. Ranked modes suppress skill-tree effects; normal-tree potency policy is unapproved, so a stacking audit precedes implementation.","Unsupported rows untouched: Shattered Reflection's mirror (100%), illuminance's move (1) and Chrono Stasis's timedilation (100%) receive no bonus. No adverse rows exist in this kit; no row is hidden, item-gated or mode-restricted."],"progression":{"currency":"Bloodright Point","abbreviation":"BP","acquired_with":"silver","acquisition_cap":4,"node_cost":1,"silver_price":null,"ownership_gate":"current bloodline","separate_from_normal_skill_points":true},"evaluation_level":25,"game_source_pin":"16498fd776fad9c91e4b84efed4380fe3a487050","snapshot":{"public_kit_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","hidden_kit_snapshot":"2026-09-30"},"audit":{"available_skills":10,"foundation_count":2,"hidden_art_count":4,"advanced_art_count":4,"bloodright_point_cap":4,"cost_per_skill":1,"maximum_advanced_arts":1,"minimum_two_advanced_cost":5,"maximum_parents_per_node":1,"maximum_depth":3,"legal_allocations_by_size":{"0":1,"1":2,"2":5,"3":10,"4":14},"full_budget_allocations":14,"non_dominated_full_allocations":14,"all_nodes_in_non_dominated_builds":true,"nodes_absent_from_non_dominated_builds":[],"maximum_tag_bonuses":{"damage":5,"increasedamagegiven":5,"increasedamagetaken":5,"decreasedamagetaken":10,"afterburn":10,"reflect":10},"supported_rows_in_kit":10,"supported_rows_by_tag":{"afterburn":1,"damage":3,"decreasedamagetaken":1,"increasedamagegiven":1,"increasedamagetaken":3,"reflect":1},"tags_targeted_by_tree":["afterburn","damage","decreasedamagetaken","increasedamagegiven","increasedamagetaken","reflect"],"supported_tags_in_kit_not_targeted":[],"revision":"Draft 2 / Light classification / forked tree","source_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","limits":["Proposed potency classification behavior; not implemented or verified in the live engine.","All existing supported tags of Eyes of the Forsaken King jutsu inherit Light potency eligibility; original combat elements and target scopes stay intact.","Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.","Damage values are raw power, not final-damage percentages; percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.","Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.","Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.","No combat simulation. g.text: BLOODRIGHT / EYES OF THE FORSAKEN KING
Draft 2 / Light classification / forked tree · Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Every Eyes of the Forsaken King jutsu: existing supported tags qualify; combat scope stays unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Throne of Broken Light path + Mantle of Exile
Judgment of the Forsaken path + Mantle of Exile
Kingdom of One path + Gaze of the Deposed
Usurper's Reckoning path + Halo of the Unbowed
IDG: Increase Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken · AB: Afterburn · REF: Reflect
FINAL EYES OF THE FORSAKEN KING TAG VALUES
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Stasis · Increase Damage Taken (each of 2 effects)
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Afterburn is an enemy debuff: while it lasts, damage the target takes adds Afterburn damage at the debuff percentage (60% cap per hit).
Lifesteal shares a 60%-of-hit leech budget with vamp; Reflect returns at most 60% of a hit.
Proposed whole-kit potency classification. Current effect-element matching alone does not provide this inheritance.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
